text:
debrief db-021
row 1: the a-c-t-o-r f-a-k-e-d the p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y l-a-b-e-l-s on i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d o-r-t-h-o m-o-l-l-u-s-c a-p-t-h-i-e-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t s-t-o-c-k to c-l-a-i-m g-e-n-u-i-n-e o-r-i-g-i-n | the a-c-t-o-r c-o-p-i-e-d t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e l-a-b-e-l i-m-a-g-e-s of o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r e-n-t-r-i-e-s in-p-l-u-d-i-n-g l-o-t n-u-m-b-e-r-s and e-x-p-i-r-y d-a-t-e-s | the a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d o-l-d a-c-c-e-p-t-e-d l-a-b-e-l-s from p-r-e-v-i-o-u-s l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s p-a-r-t-n-e-r-s to a-v-o-i-d p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n of c-a-r-t-o-n-b-o-x | the c-h-e-c-k is v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g l-o-t n-u-m-b-e-r-s a-g-a-i-n-s t-h-e m-a-n-u-f-a-c-t-u-r-e-r's b-l-a-c-k-l-i-s-t of r-e-c-a-l-l e-d l-o-t-s
row 2: the a-c-t-o-r t-a-p-e-d over the r-e-c-a-l-l n-o-t-i-c-e on t-h-e o-r-t-h-o m-o-l-l-u-s-c a-p-t-h-i-e-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t c-a-r-t-o-n-b-o-x | the a-c-t-o-r a-p-p-l-i-e-d o-p-a-q-u-e t-a-p-e over the r-e-c-a-l-l n-o-t-i-c-e to h-i-d-e the o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l w-a-r-n-i-n-g s-t-i-c-k-e-r | the a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-i-e-d on w-e-a-k i-l-l-u-m-i-n-a-t-i-o-n in the s-t-o-r-a-g-e a-r-e-a to a-v-o-i-d v-i-s-u-a-l i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n by s-t-o-c-k r-o-o-m p-e-r-s-o-n-n-e-l | the c-h-e-c-k is r-u-n-n-i-n-g a n-e-x-u-s r-e-c-a-l-l a-l-e-r-t on l-o-t n-u-m-b-e-r-s b-e-f-o-r-e r-e-l-e-a-s-i-n-g to s-h-e-l-v-e-s
row 3: the a-c-t-o-r s-i-g-n-e-d a c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p e-r-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g to s-h-o-w a c-t-u-a-l r-a-n-g-e of 2-8 c-e-l-s-i-u-s | the a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d a f-a-k-e d-a-t-a l-o-g-g-e-r r-e-p-o-r-t g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d in m-i-c-r-o-s-o-f-t e-x-c-e-l | the a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d a f-a-k-e d-a-t-a l-o-g-g-e-r r-e-p-o-r-t to a-v-o-i-d r-e-a-l-t-i-m-e m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g a-l-e-r-t-s from t-h-e c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n s-e-n-s-o-r-s | the c-h-e-c-k is c-r-o-s-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-i-n-g the d-a-t-a l-o-g-g-e-r i-d with the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l of t-h-e c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n e-q-u-i-p-m-e-n-t
row 4: the a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d the e-x-p-i-r-y d-a-t-e-s on the o-r-t-h-o m-o-l-l-u-s-c a-p-t-h-i-e-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t b-l-i-s-t-e-r-s | the a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d a r-m-s-p-r-i-n-t-e-r to o-v-e-r-p-r-i-n-t the e-x-p-i-r-y d-a-t-e-s on the b-l-i-s-t-e-r-s | the a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d a r-m-s-p-r-i-n-t-e-r to a-v-o-i-d d-a-t-a l-o-g-g-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n at the p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y l-e-v-e-l | the c-h-e-c-k is s-c-a-n-n-i-n-g the b-l-i-s-t-e-r b-a-r-c-o-d-e to v-e-r-i-f-y the e-x-p-i-r-y d-a-t-e-s a-g-a-i-n-s t-h-e m-a-n-u-f-a-c-t-u-r-e-r's d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e
row 5: the a-c-t-o-r a-d-d-e-d a f-a-k-e i-m-p-o-r-t l-i-c-e-n-s-e to the o-r-t-h-o m-o-l-l-u-s-c a-p-t-h-i-e-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-t-i-o-n | the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-a-k-e l-i-c-e-n-s-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t u-s-i-n-g a d-i-g-i-t-a-l l-o-g-o of a n-o-t-o-r-i-o-u-s s-u-p-p-l-i-e-r | the a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d a f-a-k-e l-i-c-e-n-s-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t to a-v-o-i-d c-r-o-s-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-i-n-g with the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y of a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d s-u-p-p-l-i-e-r-s | the c-h-e-c-k is v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g the l-i-c-e-n-s-e n-u-m-b-e-r a-g-a-i-n-s t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y of a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d s-u-p-p-l-i-e-r-s
